title: EasyScript
features:
⚡ EasyScript - All-in-One Roblox Script

EasyScript is an all-in-one Roblox script with 22+ modules covering combat, visuals, movement, trolling, avatars, players and utilities. Everything you need in one clean client.

✨ Features

🎯 Aimbot - FOV, smoothing, head/torso targeting & more
👁️ ESP - Multiple styles with names, distance, health & NPC support
🎨 Shaders - 7 visual presets, bloom, sun rays, shadows & depth of field
🏷️ Custom Nametags - Custom titles, fonts, gradients & animated GIFs
🕊️ Fly - Adjustable speed with custom flight animations
💨 Speedhack - Multiple movement modes
👻 NoClip - Walk through walls, floors & doors
🫥 Invisible - Hide your character from other players
📍 Teleport & Waypoints - Teleport to players, cursor locations & saved spots
😂 Trolling & Actions - Sit, piggyback, orbit, carry, fling & more
💃 UGC Emotes - Browse, search and favorite emotes from the Roblox catalog
🏃 UGC Animations - Use catalog Walk, Run & Idle animation packages
🎹 Auto Piano - Searchable song library with tempo, seek & pause
🌐 Server Browser - Browse servers with player count, FPS & ping
👤 Player Tools - Spectate, mute, account info & more
🛡️ Staff Detector - Get alerted when staff join
🚫 Anti-AFK & Voice Tools (Anti Voice Chat Ban)
⚙️ Custom Settings & Keybinds
🔄 Live Updates - Always loads the latest version automatically

Join our Discord Server for Giveaways and more: https://discord.gg/easymarket

One script. 22+ modules. Endless possibilities. 🚀
